nodes.title: Troubleshooting
widgets_values:
Troubleshooting:
Turn off Nodes 2.0 in comfyui.
Make sure your GPU driver, comfyui system and all your custom nodes are up to date.

Custom node conflicts:
Easy workaround for a clean custom nodes folder: Copy/save your custom_nodes folder under a different name. Delete all custom nodes in your original folder (except manager). Restart comfyui and install all missing nodes.

If node conflicts still arise or nodes not installable, check the github pages for workarounds. 
If you struggle with "unsolvable" issues you might consider to install a separate comfyui system just for video generation, like "Comfyui-Easy-Install.

If you get OOM VRAM errors with long videos try to reduce resolution.
If you get server crashes caused by OOM RAM issues, check/increase your swap file.

nodes.title: How to use this workflow
widgets_values:
Preperation:

1. Download all models and save them at the specified directories.
2. Select/check in every blue model loader node your downloaded models.


Run:
1. Go to group "Input" and select your option in the black switch node (make sure you have selected only 1 option).
2. Set "Clip Length" and optional seed.
3. Enter your prompt.
4. Choose/select optional Loras
5. Go to your selected group and make all necessary inputs in the brown input nodes and load your files in the green           
   loader nodes.
6. Click start.

nodes.title: Lora
widgets_values:
Don`t delete/turn off the first two Loras:

1. ltx-2-19b-distilled-lora_resized_dynamic_fro09_avg_rank_175_fp8.safetensors
   Destilled Lora for low steps generation.

2. LTX-2-Image2Vid-Adapter.safetensors
   This Lora is mostly necessary for audio syncronised movements. Witout the Lora
   you might get "static" outputs without any movements.

Feel free to use any additional Loras you like.

nodes.title: Set "Clip length" in 00 Inputs
widgets_values: set "Clip Length" = loaded video length + additional video length

nodes.title: Prompt
widgets_values:
Short hint to create your prompt:

1. Short description of your loaded video
2. "the video continues with"
3. full description of the action you want to add

nodes.title: All-In-One LTX-2 Workflow, runs perfect with RTX 3060 GPU with 12 GB VRAM
widgets_values:
Simple to use all-In-One LTX-2 workflow with options for Text/Image/Video/Audio to Video + Audio.

Requirements:
- GPU with 12 GB VRAM (maybe it will work with less, but not tested)
- 32 GB VRAM
- Swap file size: 64 - 128 GB


Runs very fast: 5 second (1280 x 864) Video: < 10 minutes.
Generation of long high quality videos in one run possible: 10 - 20 seconds without any issues,
Testrun: 30 second video (1024 x 704) tooks around 40 minutes without anny OOM errors. Longer videos might be possible, but not tested yet.

Brilliant audio generation (speech/sound) with LTX-2.

Simple to use workflow:
- easy switching between all options with Fast Groups Bypasser,
- all steps highly automated: no manual frame or aspect ratio calculations necessary,
- easy to set inputs by predefined sliders (no risk to set wrong inputs, like wrong aspect ratios or wrong frame 
  counts).


Important:
This workflow is intended for advanced comfyui users who know how to install and operate the system and are able to resolve basic system errors themselves, like as node conflicts, or general system issues.

nodes.title: About this workflow
widgets_values:
This workflow is mainly based on the fantastic LTX-2 workflows of Urabewe: https://civitai.com/models/2304098.
As far as I know, those were the first workflows running LTX-2 with 12 GB VRAM. All credits goes to the original creator.

My job was only to combine and organise the different workflows in a hopfully simple to use all-in-one design, adding some simple calculations and sliders to make inputs as simple as possible and running lot of tests to do some minor optimisations, getting the limits and hopfully killing all bugs.

What comes next? My intention is to add the folowing parts:
- integrating Urabewe`s text + audio to video workflow,
- adding different audio engines for integrated more complex audio generation.
